summary: Independent verification of the autocomplete focus-jump bug fix on the /autocomplete-preview harness: PASSED. Typed 'knee' and 'scr' letter-by-letter (250ms pause per letter) - document.activeElement stayed on the typed input after EVERY letter and the Age input remained empty throughout. Layout assertion confirmed the suggestion list is INLINE in normal flow (computed position: relative, z-index: 0): suggestion box top (219px) >= procedure input bottom (215px), and the Implant input was pushed DOWN to 388px (below the suggestion box bottom of 353px) instead of being overlapped. Tapping suggestion 0 filled the Procedure input with 'Knee Arthroscopy' and closed the list. Implant suggestions show stock details ('Screw 6.5mm Cancellous / 24 in stock', 'Cortical Screw 3.5mm / 40 in stock'). Regression PASSED: /patient-form renders all three autocomplete fields with exact expected placeholders, quick-pick chip scrollers render nothing on web without crashing (expected - stub DB), login screen renders with email input and submit button. No console errors and no red error screens on any page. Code review of AutocompleteField.tsx confirms the fix: dropdown style has no position:absolute, no zIndex, no elevation, no shadow props (only the small clear-X button retains position:absolute, which is fine). NOTE: an initial file read returned a stale pre-fix version; verified on disk and via git status that the inline fix is what is actually deployed.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecated 'shadow*' style props still used (shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset) - Metro web bundle logs warning '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"'. References: frontend/src/components/toast.tsx:64-68, frontend/src/components/Segmented.tsx:51-55, frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:471-475. AutocompleteField.tsx itself is clean (shadows removed with the inline fix). Warning-only on web; not blocking.

action_items: Delete the temporary harness route frontend/app/autocomplete-preview.tsx before shipping (main agent already planned this).
Optional/low priority: migrate remaining shadow* props to boxShadow in toast.tsx, Segmented.tsx, and (tabs)/index.tsx to silence the web deprecation warning.

Bug fix itself is verified - no further fix needed. Final confirmation of the focus fix on a physical Android device via Expo Go is recommended since the original bug was Android-specific re-layout behaviour.
critical_code_review_comments: AutocompleteField.tsx fix is correct and minimal: dropdown renders inline in normal flow (no position/zIndex/elevation), list only mounts when matches exist, onBlur uses 150ms timeout so suggestion taps register before close. No DRY/size issues (169 lines).
patient-form.tsx wires the three AutocompleteField instances correctly with suggestions derived from procedure catalogue + past records and inventory stock counts.
Web preview stub DB behaviour (empty reads, throwing writes) is by design - not reported as a bug.
seed_data_creation: None. Harness route uses hardcoded local mock suggestions (procedures/implants) - no network or DB involved.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Focus-jump bug fix VERIFIED on web harness. /autocomplete-preview is a temporary route - main agent will delete it; if it 404s in a future iteration that is expected, then re-verify via /patient-form rendering only (web has no suggestion data by design). Remaining known cosmetic issue: shadow* deprecation warnings from toast.tsx/Segmented.tsx/(tabs)/index.tsx.
rca_of_issue: Original bug: suggestion dropdown was an absolute-positioned overlay with a conditional zIndex (wrapRaised zIndex:50 + elevation:10). On Android, mounting that overlay mid-typing forced the KeyboardAwareScrollView to re-layout/re-elevate, stealing focus and scroll position after the first letter (user got jumped to the Age field). Fix: render the suggestion list inline in normal flow below the input with no zIndex/elevation/shadow changes, so no re-layout of the scroll view occurs while typing. Verified: focus retained after every keystroke, Age stays empty, list pushes following fields down instead of overlapping.
